column1: # THE CHILDREN OF DON LUIS LERENA (y Fernandez) AND DONA JUSTINIANA LENGUAS.
# Found 13 September 2026 by searching on the MOTHER - Justiniana Lenguas - which is what finally
# broke this open. Searching the surname LERENA had never worked, because the Montevideo clerks
# and the FamilySearch indexers between them wrote the family as Lerena, Lorena, Serena and Languas.
# *** THIS IS THE GENERATION ABOVE THE MONTEVIDEO TRUNK, and it puts GILBERTO in it. ***

column3: christened 7 January 1846, Medalla Milagrosa y San Agustin, Montevideo
column4: Luis Eugenes, parents Justiniana Lenguas + Luis Serena
column5: Uruguay Catholic Church Records; index ark 1:1:68X5-SFB8

column3: christened 7 January 1846, Medalla Milagrosa y San Agustin - the SAME DAY as Luis Eugenio

column6: SECONDARY - index. Two children cannot both be born in Feb and July of 1843; one of the two indexed birth dates is wrong. They were plainly baptised together.

column3: named as a FATHER on two of his own children's records, both giving his parents as Luis and Justiniana Lenguas
column4: Gilberto Lerena, parents Justiniana Lenguas + Luis; wife Julia Salvanach / Salvancich
column5: Uruguay Catholic Church Records; index arks 1:1:6D38-DNHP and 1:1:6DFW-VY4P
column6: SECONDARY - two independent index records agree. *** THIS MAKES GILBERTO A BROTHER OF LUIS EUGENIO *** - the co-founder of the Argentine Stud Book, the man the Gran Premio Gilberto Lerena is named for, is of the same Montevideo household. The racing dynasty and the Rosario baptism join here.
